title.en: Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei Announce Divorce, Ending 11-Year Marriage
title.zh-TW: 方志友、楊銘威宣布離婚　11年婚姻告終：永遠是家人

summary.en: Taiwanese actors Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei have confirmed their divorce, ending an 11-year marriage that began when Fang was 24 and pregnant. The pair said they "can't be lovers anymore" but will "always be family." Outlets agree on the split; the reasons remain private.
summary.zh-TW: 藝人方志友、楊銘威證實離婚，結束11年婚姻。兩人當年24歲奉子成婚，聲明表示「無法再做情人」，但「永遠是家人」。各媒體對離婚事實說法一致，詳細原因未公開。

body.en:
What happened
Taiwanese actors Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei have announced their divorce, ending 11 years of marriage. The pair married young — Fang was 24 and pregnant at the time — and said in their joint statement that while they "can't be lovers anymore," they will "always be family." China Times reports the marriage has formally ended; Yahoo News notes Yang has since made his first public appearance, with his latest status drawing attention. Taiwan media have also revisited the couple's rumored "four major grudges" and a past episode in which Yang was said to mention divorce after drinking, with actress Alyssa Chia quoted describing him as acting "like a lord" at home — though neither party has confirmed these details.
Why it matters
The split lands amid a wave of high-profile Taiwan entertainment breakups filling local feeds, and the couple's carefully worded "family forever" framing has set the tone for coverage: outlets are treating the divorce as amicable unless new details emerge.
Sources agree / disagree
China Times, Yahoo News, EBC, LINE TODAY and NOWnews agree the marriage is over and cite the same joint statement, with the 11-year timeline consistent across outlets. Figures of 3 versus 11 years appearing in some headlines come from an unrelated story swept into the same news cluster (see below), not from disagreement about this divorce.
Still uncertain
The specific reasons for the split have not been disclosed. Note: this cluster also contains an unrelated divorce rumor about a different local male star — a "3-year marriage" infidelity story involving a recording studio — which should be treated as a separate story, not part of the Fang-Yang split.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
藝人方志友、楊銘威宣布離婚，結束11年婚姻。兩人當年24歲奉子成婚，聲明中表示「無法再做情人」，但「永遠是家人」。中時新聞網報導11年婚姻正式告終；Yahoo新聞指出楊銘威離婚後首度公開現身，近況受關注。台媒也翻出兩人過往傳出的「夫妻四大心結」，以及楊銘威曾被爆酒後把「離婚」掛嘴邊、賈靜雯（Alyssa Chia）形容他在家「像大爺」等說法，但雙方均未證實細節。
為什麼重要
這起離婚案落在台灣演藝圈一波婚變潮之中，兩人以「永遠是家人」定調，各媒體目前多以和平分手角度報導，除非有新事證出現。
來源異同
中時、Yahoo、東森、LINE TODAY、NOWnews對離婚事實與11年時間軸說法一致，均引述同一份聯合聲明。部分標題出現的「3年」與「11年」數字差異，來自混入同群組的另一則不相關新聞，並非針對本案的分歧。
仍不確定
離婚具體原因未公開。另註：本群組另混入一則不相關的婚變傳聞（某本土男星「3年婚」外遇錄音間事件），請視為獨立事件，與方志友、楊銘威無關。

disagreements.en: Some headlines in this feed cluster mention a "3-year" marriage versus "11 years" — this reflects an unrelated divorce story mixed into the same cluster, not a dispute about the Fang-Yang marriage.
disagreements.zh-TW: 群組內部分標題出現「3年婚」與「11年」的數字差異，來自混入同群組的另一則不相關婚變新聞，並非針對方楊離婚的分歧。

blurb.en: Taiwanese actress; married Yang Mingwei at 24 and is now divorcing him after 11 years.

blurb.en: Taiwanese actor; announced divorce from Fang Zhiyou and has since made his first public appearance.

blurb.zh-TW: 台灣女藝人；東森報導引述其談論楊銘威在家中的表現。
blurb.en: Taiwanese actress quoted by EBC commenting on Yang's behavior at home.

blurb.zh-TW: 台灣新聞媒體；報導兩人11年婚姻正式告終。
blurb.en: Taiwanese news outlet; reported the formal end of the 11-year marriage.

blurb.zh-TW: 台灣電視台；報導楊銘威酒後提離婚等消息。

title.en: YouTuber Xiao Wu Dissolves 9-Year Team; Partner Sheng Yuan Spotted Calm on Taipei MRT
title.zh-TW: 小吳解散9年公司　聖元獨自現身捷運神情平靜

summary.en: Taiwanese YouTuber Xiao Wu, known as "見習網美小吳", announced the dissolution of her 9-year team on social media late last month. Around the same time, a CTWANT reader spotted her partner Sheng Yuan riding the MRT's Zhonghe-Xinlu line alone, looking calm and composed.
summary.zh-TW: YouTuber「見習網美小吳」上月25日在社群宣布解散經營9年的公司。同一時間，CTWANT讀者在捷運中和新蘆線巧遇其夥伴聖元獨自搭車，神情平靜，似乎已坦然接受團隊決定。

body.en:
What happened
Taiwanese YouTuber Xiao Wu, known online as "見習網美小吳", has dissolved the team she ran for nine years, announcing the decision in a social media post on the 25th of last month. The move surprised fans who had followed the group's long run. Around the same time, a reader of the weekly CTWANT spotted her longtime partner Sheng Yuan riding Taipei's MRT Zhonghe-Xinlu line alone. ETtoday reports he appeared in public with no disguise and looked calm throughout the ride, seemingly at peace with the team's decision.
Why it matters
A nine-year run is an eternity in the creator economy, and the abrupt end of a well-known Taiwanese YouTube team has fans reading the MRT sighting for clues about the split's tone — so far, the signals point to an amicable parting rather than a falling-out.
Sources agree / disagree
ETtoday and CTWANT (via LINE TODAY and Yahoo) agree on the core facts: the 9-year team is dissolved, and Sheng Yuan was seen alone on the MRT looking composed. Coverage differs only in angle — CTWANT frames it as a captured celebrity sighting; ETtoday emphasizes his unguarded, calm demeanor.
Still uncertain
Xiao Wu has not detailed why the team was dissolved, and Sheng Yuan has not commented publicly. Whether the two will continue collaborating in some form is not yet known.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
YouTuber「見習網美小吳」宣布解散經營9年的團隊，上月25日在社群平台發文投下震撼彈，讓長期追隨的粉絲相當意外。同一時間，時報周刊CTWANT讀者在捷運中和新蘆線巧遇小吳的夥伴聖元獨自搭車。ETtoday報導，他全程0偽裝現身，神情相當平靜，似乎早已坦然接受團隊的決定。
為什麼重要
9年在創作者經濟中是極長的壽命，知名台灣YouTube團隊突然解散，粉絲自然從聖元被拍的神情解讀分手氣氛——目前跡象指向和平分手，而非撕破臉。
來源異同
ETtoday與CTWANT（經LINE TODAY、Yahoo轉載）對核心事實說法一致：9年團隊解散、聖元獨自搭捷運神情平靜。差異只在角度：CTWANT以「被捕獲」的直擊口吻報導，ETtoday則強調他毫不遮掩的坦然反應。
仍不確定
小吳未說明解散團隊的原因，聖元也未公開回應。兩人未來是否以其他形式合作，目前未知。

blurb.en: Taiwanese YouTuber who dissolved her 9-year production team.

title.en: Paul McCartney Says Taylor Swift Personally Asked Him to Play Her Wedding
title.zh-TW: 保羅·麥卡尼（Paul McCartney）揭密：泰勒絲（Taylor Swift）親自邀他婚禮演出

summary.en: Paul McCartney has revealed he performed at Taylor Swift's wedding simply because "she asked me to do it," in a new Rolling Stone interview. The Beatles legend also discussed banning Larry David from his concerts after David refused to sing "Hey Jude" on Jimmy Kimmel Live.
summary.zh-TW: 保羅·麥卡尼（Paul McCartney）接受滾石（Rolling Stone）訪問，透露在泰勒絲（Taylor Swift）婚禮上演出只因「她親自開口邀請」。他也談到因賴瑞·大衛（Larry David）在吉米·基墨（Jimmy Kimmel）節目拒唱〈Hey Jude〉，將其列入演唱會黑名單。

body.en:
What happened
Paul McCartney has explained why he took the stage at Taylor Swift's wedding: "She asked me to do it." In a new Rolling Stone interview, the former Beatle said Swift personally invited him to perform. According to earlier coverage, McCartney performed "I Want to Hold Your Hand" at the celebration. In the same interview, McCartney also talked about banning comedian Larry David from his concerts — reportedly after David refused to sing along to "Hey Jude" during an appearance on Jimmy Kimmel Live.
Why it matters
Wedding performances by rock royalty are usually shrouded in secrecy, so McCartney's matter-of-fact explanation is a rare direct confirmation of how the year's most talked-about celebrity wedding set came about. The Larry David anecdote, meanwhile, shows the legend still keeps a list.
Sources agree / disagree
Billboard and Rolling Stone each carry one half of this cluster: Billboard reports Swift's "The Life of a Showgirl" returning to No. 1 on the Billboard 200 for a 13th nonconsecutive week after its Sept. 25 "Encore" reissue with four previously unreleased songs; Rolling Stone carries the McCartney wedding interview. These are two separate stories grouped by topic, and neither outlet disputes the other's facts.
Still uncertain
McCartney has not said whether he will discuss the wedding performance further, and Swift's camp has not commented beyond what the interview contains. The feed summaries do not give a date for the David concert ban.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
保羅·麥卡尼（Paul McCartney）揭開在泰勒絲（Taylor Swift）婚禮登台的原因：「她親自開口邀請。」這位前披頭四成員在滾石（Rolling Stone）新專訪中表示，泰勒絲親自邀他演出；據先前報導，他在婚禮上演唱了〈I Want to Hold Your Hand〉。同場訪問中，麥卡尼也談到將喜劇演員賴瑞·大衛（Larry David）列入演唱會黑名單——據傳起因是大衛在吉米·基墨（Jimmy Kimmel）節目上拒絕跟唱〈Hey Jude〉。
為什麼重要
搖滾傳奇的婚禮演出通常神祕低調，麥卡尼直白的說法是罕見的第一手證實，解開今年最受矚目的名人婚禮演出之謎。賴瑞·大衛的插曲則顯示，這位傳奇人物記仇記得很清楚。
來源異同
告示牌（Billboard）與滾石各占群組一半：告示牌報導泰勒絲〈The Life of a Showgirl〉在9月25日「Encore」加值版（收錄4首未發表曲）帶動下，以21名躍升重返告示牌200冠軍、累計13週非連續冠軍；滾石則刊出麥卡尼婚禮專訪。這是兩則因主題被歸入同組的獨立新聞，雙方事實互不衝突。
仍不確定
麥卡尼未說是否會再談婚禮演出，泰勒絲方面除訪問內容外也未回應。摘要中未載明大衛被禁的確切時間。

blurb.zh-TW: 前披頭四成員；透露泰勒絲親自邀他婚禮演出。
blurb.en: Former Beatle; revealed Swift personally asked him to play her wedding.

title.en: Trump Renews $5,000 Check Pledge, Touts Smaller Payments as Midterms Near
title.zh-TW: 川普（Trump）重申發放5000美元支票　期中選舉逼近先推小額給付

summary.en: Donald Trump is reiterating his pledge to send Americans $5,000 checks — contingent on Republicans keeping Congress — while promoting two federal payment programs already underway. The push comes as the US jobs market slows sharply a month before the midterms.
summary.zh-TW: 唐納·川普（Donald Trump）重申發放每人5000美元支票的承諾（以共和黨保住國會為前提），同時宣傳兩項已上路的聯邦給付計畫。此時美國就業市場在期中選舉前一個月明顯降溫。

body.en:
What happened
Donald Trump is renewing his pledge to send $5,000 checks to Americans, making the dividend contingent on Republicans retaining control of Congress. At the same time, he is promoting two federal payment programs already underway and highlighting smaller payments already being distributed. CNBC reports the renewed push comes with the midterm elections about a month away. Separately, the BBC reports the US jobs market is seeing a sharp slowdown ahead of the midterms, with unemployment rising slightly as American employers pause hiring.
Why it matters
Direct-payment promises have become a recurring midterm-season tool, and tying the $5,000 pledge to a Republican Congress makes the check an explicit electoral incentive. The slowing labor market gives the pitch a receptive audience — and raises the stakes of the economic argument both parties will make in the final month.
Sources agree / disagree
CNBC and the BBC cover different halves of the story — CNBC on the $5,000 pledge and the smaller payments, the BBC on the jobs-market slowdown — and neither contradicts the other. The feed summaries do not spell out the mechanics or eligibility of the two existing payment programs.
Still uncertain
Whether the $5,000 dividend has any legislative path is unclear from the summaries; it remains a campaign pledge conditioned on the election outcome. Details of the smaller payments — amounts, recipients, funding — are not specified in the available snippets.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
唐納·川普（Donald Trump）重申發放每人5000美元支票的承諾，並以共和黨保住國會控制權為前提。同時他宣傳兩項已上路的聯邦給付計畫，強調已有小額款項發放中。CNBC報導，這波承諾距離期中選舉約一個月。另一方面，BBC報導美國就業市場在期中選舉前明顯降溫，雇主暫停徵才，失業率小幅上升。
為什麼重要
直接發錢承諾已成期中選舉季的固定戲碼，把5000美元與共和黨國會掛鉤，更讓支票成為明確的選舉誘因。疲軟的就業市場讓這套說法更有聽眾，也拉高兩黨最後一個月經濟攻防的賭注。
來源異同
CNBC與BBC各報導故事的一半：CNBC談5000美元承諾與小額給付，BBC談就業市場降溫，兩者互不衝突。摘要中未說明兩項現行給付計畫的運作方式與資格條件。
仍不確定
5000美元支票是否有立法路徑，摘要中看不出來；目前仍是附帶選舉條件的競選承諾。小額給付的金額、對象與財源，現有摘要也未載明。

blurb.zh-TW: 美國總統；重申5000美元支票承諾，與期中選舉掛鉤。
blurb.en: US president; renewed the $5,000 check pledge tied to the midterms.

blurb.zh-TW: 美國財經新聞網；報導5000美元承諾與小額給付。
blurb.en: US business news network; reported the $5,000 pledge.

blurb.zh-TW: 英國公共廣播公司；報導美國就業市場降溫。
blurb.en: British public broadcaster; reported the US jobs slowdown.

blurb.zh-TW: 美國總統任期中舉行的國會選舉；約一個月後登場。
blurb.en: US congressional elections held midway through a presidential term; about a month away.

blurb.zh-TW: 川普稱已上路的兩項聯邦給付計畫，細節未明。
blurb.en: Two government payment programs Trump says are already underway; details unclear.

imageAlt.en: Cover related to: Trump Orders 'Super Intelligence' as New Name for AI; Tech Chiefs Fall in Line
imageAlt.zh-TW: 相關封面圖：川普（Trump）下令AI改稱「超級智慧」　科技巨頭配合

title.en: Trump Orders 'Super Intelligence' as New Name for AI; Tech Chiefs Fall in Line
title.zh-TW: 川普（Trump）下令AI改稱「超級智慧」　科技巨頭乖乖配合

summary.en: Donald Trump wants artificial intelligence rebranded as "super intelligence" — SI, the same initials as Slovenian internet domains. Wired frames the move as a loyalty test for tech executives that worked; the BBC reports "unprecedented" demand for Slovenian website names.
summary.zh-TW: 唐納·川普（Donald Trump）要求將人工智慧改稱為「超級智慧」（SI），恰與斯洛維尼亞網域名縮寫相同。Wired形容這是對科技高管的忠誠度測試且奏效；BBC報導斯洛維尼亞網域名出現「前所未有」的搶註潮。

body.en:
What happened
Donald Trump wants the term "AI" retired in favor of "super intelligence" — abbreviated SI, which happens to be the same two letters used by Slovenian internet domains. Wired describes the rebrand as a loyalty test for technology executives: after years of gushing about AI, the piece says, billionaire tech chiefs "meekly went along when Trump canceled the term." The BBC, meanwhile, reports the rebrand has triggered "unprecedented" demand for Slovenian (.si) website names as speculators and businesses rush to register domains matching the new initialism.
Why it matters
Presidents have long tried to shape the language of technology, but rarely does a naming whim move a domain market overnight. The episode doubles as a read on the current power balance between Washington and Silicon Valley: public deference from executives who once set the AI agenda themselves.
Sources agree / disagree
Wired and the BBC agree on the basic fact — Trump is pushing "super intelligence" as the replacement term — and cover complementary angles: Wired on executive compliance, the BBC on the Slovenian domain rush. Neither outlet disputes the other's account.
Still uncertain
It is unclear whether any formal directive or executive order underpins the rebrand, or whether it remains presidential rhetoric. The BBC describes domain demand as "unprecedented," but no specific registration numbers appear in the feed summary.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
唐納·川普（Donald Trump）希望淘汰「AI」一詞，改稱「超級智慧」（super intelligence），縮寫SI恰好與斯洛維尼亞網域名相同。Wired將此形容為對科技高管的忠誠度測試：文中稱，這些億萬富豪高管多年來對AI讚不絕口，川普一聲令下便「乖乖配合」。BBC則報導，改名已引發斯洛維尼亞（.si）網域名「前所未有」的搶註潮，投機者與企業搶著註冊符合新縮寫的網址。
為什麼重要
總統試圖形塑科技語言並不稀奇，但一句話一夜之間牽動網域市場實屬罕見。這起事件也是華府與矽谷權力消長的縮影：曾經主導AI議程的高管，如今公開順從。
來源異同
Wired與BBC對基本事實說法一致——川普正推動以「超級智慧」取代AI，只是角度互補：Wired談高管配合，BBC談斯洛維尼亞網域搶註潮。雙方報導互不衝突。
仍不確定
改名背後是否有正式指令或行政命令，抑或僅止於總統喊話，目前不明。BBC形容網域需求「前所未有」，但摘要中未給出具體註冊數字。

blurb.zh-TW: 美國總統；下令將AI改稱「超級智慧」。
blurb.en: US president; ordered AI rebranded as "super intelligence".

title.en: MIT News Documents the Tech Worker Movement, From Dot-Com Crash to Today
title.zh-TW: MIT新聞（MIT News）記錄科技勞工運動　從網路泡沫到今日

summary.en: An MIT News feature traces the tech worker movement from the 2000 dot-com crash to the present. Despite the bust, technology remained a magnet for workers who saw it as the future — and grew into a dominant force in the labor market.
summary.zh-TW: MIT新聞（MIT News）專題回顧科技勞工運動，從2000年網路泡沫走到今日。儘管泡沫破裂，科技業仍吸引相信科技即未來的工作者，逐漸成為勞動市場的主導力量。

body.en:
What happened
MIT News has published a feature documenting the tech worker movement, tracing its arc from the 2000 dot-com crash to the present day. The piece notes that even after the crash, the technology industry remained an attractive destination for workers who believed technology represented the future. The digital age — defined by global connectivity and computers — had firmly taken hold, and over time the tech industry emerged as a dominant force in the labor market, drawing engineers, designers and professionals across a wide range of high-paying roles.
Why it matters
Tech workers' collective action — from walkouts to union drives — has become one of the defining labor stories of the digital era, yet its history is still being written. A documented account from an institution like MIT gives the movement a historical record beyond headlines and company statements.
Sources agree / disagree
This is currently a single-outlet item from MIT News; no other allow-listed outlet in the feed set has picked it up, so there is no corroboration or dispute to report.
Still uncertain
The feed summary excerpts only the opening of the feature; its full scope, interviews and conclusions are in the MIT News piece itself.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
MIT新聞（MIT News）刊出專題，記錄科技勞工運動的發展軌跡，從2000年網路泡沫一路寫到今日。文中指出，即便泡沫破裂，科技業對相信「科技即未來」的工作者仍具吸引力。全球連網與電腦定義的數位時代已經成形，科技業逐漸成為勞動市場的主導力量，吸納工程師、設計師與各領域高薪專業人才。
為什麼重要
科技勞工的集體行動——從罷工到組工會——已是數位時代最具代表性的勞工故事之一，但其歷史仍在書寫。來自MIT這樣的機構的系統性記錄，讓這場運動留下超越頭條與公司聲明的歷史檔案。
來源異同
目前僅MIT新聞單一來源報導，群組內其他媒體尚未跟進，無從佐證也無分歧可記。
仍不確定
摘要僅節錄專題開頭；完整篇幅、訪談與結論請見MIT新聞原文。

title.en: MIT Profiles Cathy Wu, Building Computational Tools for Society's Hardest Problems
title.zh-TW: MIT專訪凱西·吳（Cathy Wu）　用運算工具解決社會最棘手難題

summary.en: MIT News profiles Cathy Wu, class of 2012, who has spent her career building computational tools for society's most complex challenges. The daughter of Taiwanese immigrants, Wu was driven by a childhood on a tight budget with a father working long commutes.
summary.zh-TW: MIT新聞（MIT News）專訪2012年畢業的凱西·吳（Cathy Wu），回顧她如何打造運算工具、解決社會最複雜的難題。身為台灣移民之女，童年家境拮据、父親長途通勤，塑造了她改善人們生活的志向。

body.en:
What happened
MIT News has profiled Cathy Wu, class of 2012 with a master's in 2013, whose work centers on computational tools for society's most complex challenges. As far back as she can remember, Wu wanted to find ways to solve problems and improve people's lives. Her parents were Taiwanese immigrants, and her father endured a long commute that took him away from the family; on a tight budget, the rest of the family often stayed home on a street too busy for children to play outdoors, and Wu and her siblings spent much of their time playing together indoors. The profile presents her drive to improve people's lives as the throughline connecting that upbringing to her research career.
Why it matters
Wu's trajectory — from a frugal immigrant household to building computational approaches to societal problems — illustrates how personal background shapes research agendas. Profiles like this also put a human face on an often abstract field.
Sources agree / disagree
This is a single-outlet MIT News profile; no other feed source has covered it, so there is nothing to corroborate or contest.
Still uncertain
The summary excerpts the profile's opening; Wu's specific projects and findings are detailed in the full MIT News piece. The excerpt also gives no sense of where her tools are being applied today — in research labs, public policy, or industry — leaving that to the full profile.

title.en: Xi Lan Clashes With Astrologer Tang Qiyang in Profanity-Laced Livestream
title.zh-TW: 錫蘭直播開嗆唐綺陽　飆髒話比中指惹議　唐冷回：不隨之起舞

summary.en: Taiwanese creator Xi Lan sparked outrage after swearing and flashing the middle finger at astrologer Tang Qiyang during a livestream, calling astrology baseless and telling her to "shut up." Tang coolly responded she would not "dance along," while a lawyer defended her online.
summary.zh-TW: 網紅錫蘭在直播中隔空開嗆占星師唐綺陽，飆髒話、比中指，批星座「沒數據」、要她「閉嘴」，引發譁然。唐綺陽冷回「不隨之起舞」；有律師發文護航，形容「天上掉下來的屎不用接」。

body.en:
What happened
Taiwanese internet personality Xi Lan ignited controversy after using a livestream to attack celebrity astrologer Tang Qiyang — swearing, flashing the middle finger and shouting "shut up" while taunting her to "look at my PPT," and dismissing astrology as made-up and unsupported by data. Multiple outlets — including Newtalk, UDN, ETtoday, Mirror Media and FTV — carried the confrontation. Tang responded coolly, saying she would not "dance along" with the provocation; one report notes she had recently foreshadowed "trouble falling from the sky," which coverage framed as an eerily accurate prediction. A lawyer publicly defended Tang, writing that unsolicited attacks are like "shit falling from the sky" — not worth catching. Coverage also revisited Tang's backstory of giving up a six-figure monthly salary to become an astrologer.
Why it matters
The clash pits Taiwan's creator economy against its celebrity astrology industry — two pillars of local online culture — and the "PPT" taunt has become its own meme. How Tang's measured non-response plays against Xi Lan's shock tactics is now the story's second act.
Sources agree / disagree
Outlets agree on the core sequence: the livestream insults, the middle finger, Tang's "won't dance along" reply and the lawyer's defense. They differ only in emphasis — some frame it as part of Xi Lan's pattern of confrontational call-outs, while others focus on Tang's composure.
Still uncertain
Whether either party will escalate — legally or on-stream — is unknown. The feed summaries do not say whether Tang plans any formal response beyond her initial cool reply.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
網紅錫蘭在直播中隔空開嗆占星師唐綺陽，飆髒話、比中指、高喊「Shut up」，還嗆「看我PPT」，批星座是瞎掰、「沒數據」，引發譁然。Newtalk、聯合報、ETtoday、鏡報、民視等多家媒體跟進報導。唐綺陽冷回「不隨之起舞」；有報導指她稍早才預告「禍從天上來」，被形容為精準命中。一名律師公開護航，寫道「天上掉下來的屎不用接」。報導也回顧唐綺陽當年放棄6位數月薪轉戰占星的心路歷程。
為什麼重要
這場衝突是台灣創作者經濟對上名人占星產業——兩大在地網路文化支柱的對撞，「看我PPT」更成了獨立迷因。唐綺陽的冷處理對上錫蘭的震撼戰術，後續如何發展已是故事的第二幕。
來源異同
各媒體對核心經過說法一致：直播飆罵、比中指、唐綺陽「不隨之起舞」的回應、律師護航。差異只在角度：部分媒體將此定位為錫蘭一貫的嗆辣開撕風格，也有的聚焦唐綺陽的沉著。
仍不確定
雙方是否會進一步升級——走法律途徑或再開直播對嗆——目前未知。摘要中未見唐綺陽除冷回應之外的正式動作。

title.en: G7 to Release Up to 100 Million Barrels of Emergency Oil and Diesel
title.zh-TW: G7將釋出最高1億桶緊急石油與柴油儲備　回應川普（Trump）斷供威脅

summary.en: G7 leaders have agreed to release up to 100 million barrels of emergency crude and diesel reserves after Donald Trump threatened to cut off US diesel supplies. The coordinated drawdown aims to head off price spikes and avert a US diesel export ban.
summary.zh-TW: 七大工業國（G7）領袖同意釋出最高1億桶緊急原油與柴油儲備，此前唐納·川普（Donald Trump）威脅切斷美國柴油供應。這波協調釋儲旨在抑制油價飆漲，並避免美國祭出柴油出口禁令。

body.en:
What happened
Leaders of the G7 nations will release up to 100 million barrels of their emergency diesel and crude oil stockpiles, after Donald Trump threatened to cut off supplies of US diesel. French President Emmanuel Macron said ministers from some of the world's largest economies had agreed to the coordinated drawdown. The release is aimed at heading off further price spikes and at avoiding a ban on US diesel exports, which the summaries frame as the scenario the release is meant to prevent.
Why it matters
A coordinated G7 stockpile release is a rare, heavyweight market intervention, and deploying it pre-emptively — before any actual supply cut — shows how seriously allies are taking Trump's threat. For consumers, it is meant to cap fuel prices heading into winter; for markets, it is a signal that governments will not let diesel become a trade weapon unanswered.
Sources agree / disagree
The Guardian and the BBC agree on the essentials: a coordinated G7 release following Trump's threat to cut US diesel supplies. They differ on the headline figure — the Guardian cites up to 100 million barrels, while the BBC's headline says "millions of barrels" without the specific number.
Still uncertain
The timing and tranche structure of the release are not detailed in the feed summaries, nor is whether Trump's threatened cutoff — or the US export ban it was meant to forestall — will actually materialize.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
七大工業國（G7）領袖將釋出最高1億桶緊急柴油與原油儲備，此前唐納·川普（Donald Trump）威脅切斷美國柴油供應。法國總統艾曼紐·馬克宏（Emmanuel Macron）表示，全球主要經濟體的部長已同意協調釋儲。此舉旨在抑制油價進一步飆漲，並避免美國祭出柴油出口禁令——摘要將後者描述為釋儲意圖防範的情境。
為什麼重要
G7協調釋儲是罕見的重磅市場干預，在實際斷供發生前就搶先出手，顯示盟國對川普威脅的重視程度。對消費者而言，這是為了壓住入冬前的燃料價格；對市場而言，則是政府不會坐視柴油淪為貿易武器的信號。
來源異同
衛報（The Guardian）與BBC對核心事實說法一致：川普威脅切斷美國柴油供應後，G7協調釋儲。差異在標題數字：衛報稱最高1億桶，BBC標題僅寫「數百萬桶」，未載明具體數字。
仍不確定
釋儲的時程與分批結構在摘要中未詳述；川普威脅的斷供、以及釋儲意圖防範的美國出口禁令是否真的會發生，目前不明。

title.en: Brazil Heads to Presidential Runoff as Flavio Bolsonaro Edges Lula
title.zh-TW: 巴西總統大選進入第二輪　弗拉維奧·波索納洛（Flavio Bolsonaro）險勝盧拉（Lula）

summary.en: Brazil's presidential race will go to an Oct. 25 runoff after far-right challenger Flavio Bolsonaro, son of jailed ex-president Jair Bolsonaro, edged incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in the first round without securing an outright majority. With more than 99% of votes counted, the margin was razor-thin; Washington is watching the polarized contest closely.
summary.zh-TW: 巴西總統大選將於10月25日舉行第二輪投票。極右派挑戰者、入獄前總統雅伊爾·波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）之子弗拉維奧·波索納洛（Flavio Bolsonaro）首輪險勝現任左派總統盧拉（Lula），但未過半。

body.en:
What happened
Brazil's presidential race will go to a second round after the first round failed to produce an outright winner. Far-right challenger Flavio Bolsonaro — son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, who is in jail — edged the incumbent left-wing president, Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, but fell short of the majority needed to avoid a runoff. With more than 99% of votes counted, the race appeared very close, the Guardian reports. If neither candidate wins more than half the votes, they will face each other again on Oct. 25. NPR notes the first round "failed to fully energize voters," setting up a more polarized contest that Washington is watching very closely.
Why it matters
A Lula-versus-Bolsonaro runoff reprises Brazil's deepest political divide, now with the Bolsonaro family's legal troubles as backdrop. The closeness of the first round suggests the runoff will be fought street by street — and the result will shape Latin America's largest economy and its alignment with Washington.
Sources agree / disagree
NPR, the Guardian and the New York Times agree on the outcome: no first-round majority, Bolsonaro ahead of Lula, runoff on Oct. 25. The outlets differ only in emphasis — NPR on voter enthusiasm and Washington's attention, the Guardian on the vote count, the Times on the tight margin.
Still uncertain
Polling for the runoff has not been detailed in these summaries, and with the margin this tight, the next three weeks of campaigning could swing the result either way.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
巴西總統大選首輪無人過半，將進入第二輪投票。極右派挑戰者弗拉維奧·波索納洛（Flavio Bolsonaro）——入獄前總統雅伊爾·波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）之子——險勝現任左派總統路易斯·伊納西奧·盧拉·達席爾瓦（Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva），但未達到免除第二輪所需的過半門檻。衛報（The Guardian）報導，開票超過99%時雙方票數非常接近。若無人拿下過半選票，兩人將於10月25日再度對決。NPR指出首輪「未能充分激發選民熱情」，第二輪將是更兩極化的對決，華府正密切關注。
為什麼重要
盧拉對決波索納洛，是巴西最深層政治分裂的重演，如今還疊加波索納洛家族的法律麻煩。首輪票數之接近，預告第二輪將是巷戰——結果將左右拉丁美洲最大經濟體的走向及其與華府的關係。
來源異同
NPR、衛報、紐約時報（The New York Times）對結果說法一致：首輪無人過半、波索納洛領先盧拉、10月25日第二輪。差異只在著重點：NPR談選民熱情與華府關注，衛報談開票進度，時報談票數接近。
仍不確定
摘要中未載明第二輪民調；票數如此接近，未來三週的競選操作足以翻盤。

title.en: Google Freezes Open-Source Bug Bounty Amid 'Significant Rise' in AI Submissions
title.zh-TW: Google凍結開源漏洞懸賞計畫　AI提交暴增致「AI垃圾」淹沒審查

summary.en: Google has frozen its open-source bug bounty program, citing a "significant rise" in AI-generated submissions. TechCrunch reports that low-quality AI output — "AI slop" — is overwhelming the human review the program depends on. Google has not said how long the freeze will last or what quality bar would justify reopening.

body.en:
What happened
Google has frozen its open-source bug bounty program after a "significant rise" in AI-generated submissions, TechCrunch reports. The flood of low-quality, AI-produced reports — dubbed "AI slop" — appears to be overwhelming the human triage and review capacity that makes a bounty program useful. The freeze applies to the open-source program; the report does not say whether Google's other bounty programs are affected.
Why it matters
Bug bounties only work if reviewers can trust that reports are worth reading. If AI-generated noise can shut down even Google's program, it is a warning for every security team relying on crowdsourced vulnerability discovery: the economics of AI-assisted submission favor volume over quality, and defenses built for human reporters are buckling. The episode points to a broader shift — as AI makes it cheap to generate plausible-looking reports, every intake pipeline built on human good faith faces the same volume-versus-veracity problem.
Sources agree / disagree
This is a single-outlet TechCrunch item; no other feed source has corroborated or disputed it.
Still uncertain
It is unclear how long the freeze will last, what threshold of submission quality would justify reopening, or whether Google will introduce AI-specific submission rules. The feed summary gives no statement from Google beyond the reported reason, nor does it say whether existing program participants were notified in advance or what will happen to reports already in the queue.

為什麼重要
漏洞懸賞的前提是審查者相信報告值得一讀。連Google的計畫都會被AI生成的雜訊逼停，這是對所有依賴群眾外包找漏洞的安全團隊的警告：AI輔助提交的經濟學獎勵數量而非品質，為人類回報者設計的防線正在失守。
來源異同
目前僅TechCrunch單一來源報導，群組內無其他媒體佐證或反駁。
仍不確定
凍結會持續多久、什麼樣的提交品質門檻足以重啟、Google是否會訂定針對AI的提交規則，目前不明。摘要中除報導的理由外，未載明Google的正式聲明。

title.en: Trump Creates 'Super Intelligence Force' for AI Policy, Names Jay Clayton to Lead
title.zh-TW: 川普（Trump）成立「超級智慧部隊」主導AI政策　任命傑伊·克萊頓（Jay Clayton）領軍

summary.en: Donald Trump has announced a "Super Intelligence Force" to coordinate government AI policy, naming national intelligence chief Jay Clayton to lead it. NPR dubs Clayton the new "AI czar" as worries over the technology grow. The task force's membership, budget and actual powers remain undisclosed.
summary.zh-TW: 唐納·川普（Donald Trump）宣布成立「超級智慧部隊」，統籌政府AI政策，並任命國家情報首長傑伊·克萊頓（Jay Clayton）領軍。NPR稱其為新任「AI沙皇」，時值各界對AI疑慮升溫。

body.en:
What happened
Donald Trump has announced a new "Super Intelligence Force" to oversee AI policy and coordinate the government's engagement with artificial intelligence. Trump said his national intelligence chief, Jay Clayton, will lead the task force — NPR's headline dubs Clayton the new "AI czar." The move is Trump's latest response to the intensifying debate over AI safety, TechCrunch notes, and comes as worries over the technology grow. The BBC's version of the story frames the announcement around the task force's policy-oversight role.
Why it matters
Putting the intelligence chief in charge signals that Washington now treats AI primarily as a national-security question rather than a purely commercial one. A single coordinating body could streamline the government's scattered AI efforts — or concentrate power over the technology's future in one office.
Sources agree / disagree
The BBC, TechCrunch and NPR agree on the core facts: the "Super Intelligence Force" name, Clayton's leadership role, and the AI-policy coordination mission. They differ only in framing — NPR emphasizes the "AI czar" title, TechCrunch the unveiling moment, the BBC the oversight function.
Still uncertain
The task force's membership, budget and actual powers are not detailed in the feed summaries, nor is how it will relate to existing AI-safety initiatives. Whether Congress will seek a role in overseeing it is also unknown.

title.en: Christa Pike May Never Fully Recover After Botched Execution, Lawyer Says
title.zh-TW: 律師：克麗絲塔·派克（Christa Pike）行刑失敗後恐無法完全康復　病房戒護中

summary.en: Christa Pike's lawyer says she may never fully recover after surviving a botched execution, with doctors still working to clear two lethal doses of pentobarbital from her body. Attorney Stephen Ferrell told CNN's Jake Tapper her hospital room is under guard as she remains on a ventilator.
summary.zh-TW: 律師表示，克麗絲塔·派克（Christa Pike）在行刑失敗倖存後可能無法完全康復，醫生仍在清除她體內兩劑致死量的戊巴比妥（pentobarbital）。委任律師史蒂芬·費雷爾（Stephen Ferrell）告訴CNN的傑克·塔珀（Jake Tapper），派克仍靠呼吸器維生，病房有人戒護。

body.en:
What happened
An attorney for Christa Pike says his client may never fully recover from her botched execution. Stephen Ferrell told CNN's Jake Tapper that doctors are still trying to clear two lethal doses of pentobarbital from Pike's body, days after she survived two execution injections. Ferrell said Pike remains hospitalized on a ventilator and that her hospital room is under guard. The BBC reports her prognosis is still unclear, while Hollywood Life traces how she survived the failed execution.
Why it matters
A survived execution is among the rarest failures in the American death-penalty system, and Pike's medical limbo raises immediate questions about the drugs, the protocol and the legal status of a prisoner the state tried — twice — to put to death. Whatever courts decide next will be watched as a precedent.
Sources agree / disagree
The BBC, TMZ and Hollywood Life agree on the essentials: the failed execution, the ongoing hospitalization, the ventilator and the guarded room. They differ only in angle — the BBC on the uncertain prognosis, TMZ on the lawyer's "may not fully recover" warning, Hollywood Life on the survival itself.
Still uncertain
Pike's long-term prognosis remains unclear, and the summaries do not say what legal proceedings, if any, will determine her status going forward.

行刑失敗倖存是美國死刑制度中最罕見的失靈之一，派克的醫療僵局立刻引發對藥物、程序，以及一個國家曾兩度試圖處死的囚犯法律地位的疑問。法院接下來的任何決定都將被視為先例。

title.en: Cornell President Calls 2024 Fraternity Gang-Rape Allegations 'Deeply Disturbing'
title.zh-TW: 康乃爾（Cornell）校長打破沉默：2024年兄弟會輪暴指控「令人深感不安」

summary.en: Cornell president Michael I. Kotlikoff has addressed the university's handling of the alleged 2024 gang rape of a student at a fraternity house, calling it "deeply disturbing" and saying the school "must do better." The student's attorney accuses campus police of failing to investigate.
summary.zh-TW: 康乃爾大學（Cornell University）校長麥可·I·科特利科夫（Michael I. Kotlikoff）首度回應2024年兄弟會集體性侵案的校方處置，稱「令人深感不安」，並說學校「必須做得更好」。受害學生的律師指控校警未確實調查。

body.en:
What happened
Cornell University president Michael I. Kotlikoff has broken his silence on the school's handling of the alleged gang rape of a junior — identified as Jane Doe — at a fraternity house in 2024. In a video statement, Kotlikoff said "what happened to Jane Doe in 2024 is deeply disturbing," that the university "must do better," and called it "a defining moment in Cornell's history." CBS News reports that Jane Doe's attorney says campus police failed to properly investigate after she reported being raped, with one CBS headline framing the allegation as a "cover-up." Lilia Luciano reports from Ithaca, New York.
Why it matters
A university president publicly conceding institutional failure is rare — and it puts Cornell's disciplinary and policing systems under a spotlight that will not fade quickly. The case has become a touchstone in the national debate over how campuses handle sexual-assault reports.
Sources agree / disagree
CBS News and NPR agree on the core facts: the 2024 allegation, the president's video statement and its key lines. They differ in emphasis — CBS centers the attorney's "cover-up" accusation, NPR the president's "deeply disturbing" framing.
Still uncertain
Whether the university will announce specific reforms or personnel consequences is not detailed in the summaries, and the underlying criminal investigation's status is unclear from the available snippets.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
康乃爾大學（Cornell University）校長麥可·I·科特利科夫（Michael I. Kotlikoff）打破沉默，回應校方對2024年兄弟會集體性侵一名大三學生（化名Jane Doe）案的處置。他在影片聲明中說：「2024年發生在Jane Doe身上的事令人深感不安」，學校「必須做得更好」，並稱這是「康乃爾歷史上的決定性時刻」。CBS新聞（CBS News）報導，Jane Doe的律師指控校警在她報案後未確實調查，CBS一篇標題更將指控定調為「掩蓋」。莉莉亞·盧西亞諾（Lilia Luciano）在紐約州綺色佳（Ithaca）現場報導。
為什麼重要
大學校長公開承認體制失靈並不常見——這讓康乃爾的紀律與校警體系站上鎂光燈下，短期內不會移開。本案已成為全美校園性侵通報處置辯論的指標案件。
來源異同
CBS新聞與NPR對核心事實說法一致：2024年指控、校長影片聲明及其關鍵語句。差異在著重點：CBS聚焦律師「掩蓋」指控，NPR聚焦校長「深感不安」的表態。
仍不確定
校方是否會宣布具體改革或人事處置，摘要中未詳述；相關刑事調查的進度也不明。
